text: __NOTOC__ Hara Alebelly is a barmaid found in the Star's Bazaar.
Harborage Guardians are Broken found guarding the Harborage of Swamp of Sorrows. A powerful top-level version appears if Horde approach the settlement.
Hanner Gembold is a dwarf jewelcrafting trainer located in the shop Deepmountain Mining & Jewelcrafting, on the north side of the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Harbinger Erothem is a draenei located at the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.
Handfuls of Duskwing Dust drop from Duskwing Flutterers, Elder Duskwings, and Agitated Duskwings on Duskfall Island in Talador.
Har'gunn the Blind was an one-eyed ogre mage who lost his eye in a duel, after which he replaced it with a fist-sized stone, discovering it to have magical properties when he did so.
Happy Feet is a buff you get when you enter the auction house at the Trade District in Stormwind or the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
The Harbingers of Twilight are twilight dragons found flying around Wyrmrest Temple in the Hour of Twilight dungeon.
Harbinger Argomen was a draenei located in the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City standing next to High Exarch Commodus and Veteran Vindicators.
Hang On In There took place at the Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
The Handmade Mobile was never made available. Draining the magic from it would have left behind a version that could be vendored.
The Handscythe of the First City is a quest reward from Containment Procedure.
Hard Leystone Deposit is a mining vein found in Stonecrown Cavern in Highmountain.
Harbinger Vor'zzyx is a n'raqi located in Island Expeditions.
Handbook of Uncivil Etiquette is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Harbor Gryphon is a quest reward from Time to Fly (Alliance).
Haoqi the Curious is a pandaren warlock seen speaking with Shani Ward at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.
Hard Leystone Ore is mined from Hard Leystone Deposits in Stonecrown Cavern in Highmountain.
Harpy Hide Quiver can be purchased from or in Alterac Valley, or from or in the Alterac Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Harklan Moongrove was a night elf alchemy vendor located at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. He was killed in the Horde attack on the refuge during the Cataclysm.

Harlown Darkweave is a night elf leatherworking vendor located in Bolyun's Camp, a nook in the mountains southwest of the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. Since the Cataclysm, he became trapped by Kaliva. He is notable for being the only vendor to sell Pattern: Herbalist's Gloves (in a limited supply).
__NOTOC__ Haris Pilton is a blood elf vendor who can be found in the World's End Tavern in the lower part of Shattrath City accompanied by her dog Tinkerbell.
Harpax is the flight master located at Cosmowrench in the Netherstorm.

One of Edwin VanCleef's closest advisors, Hartargan Stark has been part of the Defias Brotherhood since the exiles first found themselves barred from Stormwind. A talented tinker, he specializes in creating nonlethal weaponry such as net guns and sling-thrown smoke bombs. Through relatives in Stormwind he maintains a large network of contacts and provides much of the Brotherhood’s inside information on the comings and goings of caravans around the city.

of Stormwind City.]] .]] Harrison Jones is an archaeologist and explorer, much like his namesake. Initially a simple joke character, Jones has become a reoccurring character with added significance, particularly during the Uldum storyline. His companions often include Adarrah, Samir and Budd Nedreck.
__NOTOC__ Hargo'then was a night elf sorcerer of the Moon Guard who was searching for the orc Broxigar during the War of the Ancients. He was killed by a fel beast which ambushed him.

Harold Winston is a jewelery vendor at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. Some time after Dalaran's removal to the Broken Isles, he stole a bag of gems that he was supposed to deliver to Debbi Moore and substituted it with a bag of fakes. Upon being confronted in the Underbelly while attempting to find a way off the city, he chose to fight instead and subsequently was killed.

Harland Wilson was a mage who, when using the spell Blink, accidentally got inserted into a statue of General Turalyon. Magma from Ironforge was used to remove him, and he emerged unharmed, but the statue was destroyed, much to the horror of nearby school children. His accident is chronicled in the book Blinking Rules & Regulations.

Harry's Bomber is an airplane belonging to "Silvermoon" Harry of the Northsea Freebooters at Scalawag Point, Howling Fjord. Harry makes his bomber available to players for the quest The Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir (quest) only. To board the vehicle the player must first speak with Alanya. She is located nearby.
Harpo Boltknuckle is a goblin flight master located at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.
Harden Carapace is a pet ability available exclusively to the beetle family of hunter pets, reducing pet damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.
Harram is a draenei located at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
Hardened Walleyes are fished from Stormwind Lake in Stormwind City.

Harden Shell was a pet ability available exclusively to the crab family of hunter pets, reducing pet damage taken by 50%. It is functionally identical to the beetle family's Harden Carapace, the turtle family's Shell Shield, and the shale spider family's Solid Shell.
Hardrogg is a drogbar singer who occasionally appears with his band of drummers — Boprul, Tinkrul and Clomprul — in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain.
Hardened Roots is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Sharpened Claws (druid artifact trait), Feral Power and Honed Instincts traits.
Hardened Defense Turret are cannons found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Harrowing Corruptors are inquisitors located at Felrage Strand of the Broken Shore. They empowered the Deepsurge naga with fel.
The Harefoot Pinnacle Wrap drops from Mynta Talonscreech in Highmountain.

Hardened Spring drops from the following mobs on Mechagon Island: *Anodized Coilbearer *Anodized Crawler *Anodized Enforcer *Anodized Machinist *Anodized Sentry *Anodized Troubleshooter *Corroded Coilbearer *Corroded Crawler *Corroded Enforcer *Corroded Machinist *Corroded Sentry *Corroded Troubleshooter *Enforcer KX-T57

Harrowing Punishment is a conduit for warriors. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
Hardened Bark Sliver is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Harrowing Gluttons are devourers located in the Shattered Grove.

Harooka is one of the oldest fishers from Taruka's clan of tuskarr. Her moustache is dyed blue, and her tusks are carved with marks of great deeds instead of the usual family or clan symbols worn by most of her kind. Taruka has never dared to ask Harooka what the marks mean, since the old fisher never talks about them herself and is known to be deadly with both a spear and her bad temper. She nearly drowned once, causing her voice to be permanently scratchy. When the clan was preparing to set off for Kamagua, Harooka sought out Taruka to warn her about a danger in Lyquokk Strait and tell her to instead take the safer route around Praak Island on her way to Kamagua. Taruka became suspicious a
Hardy is a pet ability available exclusively to the camel family of hunter pets.
Harmonic Echo is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Harmonic Echo.
Harmonious Apparatus is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Harmonious Apparatus.

Harthal Truesight has a large statue erected in his honor in the the Hall of Champions, located in the Scarlet Monastery in the Tirisfal Glades. His condition is unknown but he was last seen entering the cursed city of Stratholme.

The Hatchet Hills is an area leading to the Amani Pass just southwest of Zul'Aman in the Ghostlands. The hills were once full of roaming forest trolls until Budd Nedreck's expedition came in and killed many of them, taking over the area. However many of the expedition members were captured. The remaining ones stayed outside and requested the assistance of heroes to aid them. After the Amani forest trolls were defeated and the expedition left the area remained quiet for a time. Until the Zandalari came forth to aid the Amani. It was then the hills were occupied by the Darkspear tribe, Farstriders, and even the Silver Covenant to prevent them from growing in power.
Hatched Egg Sacs are looted from Deepmoss Eggs in Stonetalon Mountains.
Hatecrest Sorceresses are naga located at the Ruins of Feathermoon and Ruins of Solarsal on Sardor Isle in Feralas. Before the Cataclysm, they could be found in Shalzaru's Lair.
Harvest Life is a talented warlock ability, available at level 15 to the Affliction and Demonology specializations.

The Harthak clan is a clan of mogu that have traveled from an unknown location to the Mogu'shan Palace to pay tribute to their king while seeking to prove themselves amongst their rival clans of Gurthan and Kargesh. The clan members are masters of wind and lightning based magic. Following their defeat by heroes, they quickly blamed the other clans and began an all out brawl. The outcome of this brawl is unknown.
Hatchet Cannoneers are orcs found on the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
Haterunner is Marius Felbane's felsaber mount, found at the Felbane Camp in Highmountain, various locations in Azsuna, and the Kingsmouth River in Zuldazar.
Hartli the Snatcher is a harpy vignette found atop Windripper Peak in Highmountain corrupting a Captured Eagle. Upon killing her, the eagle is freed and flies away.

Hath'ar Necromagi are nerubians near the crashed necropolis Kolramas in Zul'Drak. They are raising the fallen members of the Argent Crusade and using them against them. In response to this Sergeant Moonshard has called for their deaths.

__NOTOC__ Hatherford is a small Kul Tiran town located just outside the city limits of Boralus in Tiragarde Sound. It is an important trade hub for the local area, and acts as a customs center for goods entering the capital. Produce from Tiragarde Sound, as well as the neighboring regions of Stormsong Valley and Drustvar, pass through in large quantities, and are screened by inspectors. Two bridges connect the town to Boralus itself, leading to the Proudmoore Barracks and Ashvane Docks. The Algerson Lumber Yard can also be found just east of Hatherford, with some lumberjacks working from the town.
Harvester of Shadows is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hateforged Cilice is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hateful Fetish is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hateful Shard-Ring is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Hatred Core is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Harvester's Dredwing Saddle is a dredbat flying mount occasionally found inside the Harvester's War Chest, the reward for completing the Venthyr Assault in the Maw.
Hatchet Cannons are cannons found at the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands during the Iron Horde Incursion. They are operated by Hatchet Cannoneers and protected by Orgrimmar Sea Dogs.
Hateful Gladiator's Totem of Indomitability is sold by the following vendors in Dalaran: *Zom Bocom *Xazi Smolderpipe *Evee Copperspring
Hateful Gladiator's Idol of Tenacity is sold by the following vendors in Dalaran: *Zom Bocom *Xazi Smolderpipe *Evee Copperspring
Hazza'rah's Charm of Magic is a Mage trinket that boosts Arcane spell damage for a brief time.

is the racial mount of void elves.]] The hawkstrider is a large flightless bird that is the blood elves' racial mount. As their name implies, hawkstriders resemble the tallstrider family, though their plumage is both larger and more vibrant. They come in a variety of bright colors and have a thin, curved beak and burning orange eyes. Epic versions include decorative armor on the chest and head. The hawkstrider's movements exhibit the same rhythmic, back-and-forth motion which characterizes the other two-legged mounts. They use a heavily modified tallstrider model, but they possess a wildly different looking exterior and a unique standing-jump and running animation. When Kael'thas led his fol

Haven of the Damned was a Warcraft III multiplayer map. Forged from the remnants of Draenor, this long-forgotten island was once a haven for outcasts. Now all that remains are relics of ancient battles and lost souls.
The Head of Baron Vardus drops from Baron Vardus in Alterac Mountains.

Hch'uu is a female sporeling child located in the center of Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh. She once got lost while running away from a fungal giant and ended up living at the orphanage in Shattrath City, where she became friends with Salandria. Her people later came and took her back to Sporeggar, where she now feels lonely in the absence of other children her age. During Children's Week, Salandria asks adventurers to take her to visit Hch'uu. The two friends agree that they'll also become adventurers when they grow up.

__NOTOC__ Hauteur is one of the fire elementals of Azuremyst Isle. He has gone insane as a result of the Exodar's crash-landing on Azuremyst, and he now demands that the local owlbeasts worship him as a god and burn effigies in his honor. One such effigy can be found at Moonwing Den on Silvermyst Isle. Previously, the fire elemental Temper tasked young shaman with saving Hauteur—by killing him. Thus, the fallen elemental could be born from his ashes anew. Temper would also allow the shaman to keep some of Hauteur's ashes for use in creating a Fire Totem.

A machinima created by Selserene, using the music "Greensleeves", and first posted on Warcraftmovies on 12-24-07 at 00:34. The machinima depicts the tale of two High Elven lovers separated at the time of the Scourge's invasion of Silvermoon. The two, although separated, lived to join separate factions, the female the Sunfury faction and the male joined the Horde with many other Sin'dorei that remained on Azeroth. Near the end of the machinima the two meet up again which then ties the ending of the machinima and the beginning of it, together. The lyrics beautifully depict the love for which the Sin'dorei have for their prince, despite what they know about him and his actions. The lyrics go as

The Havenshire Stables are located in north-central Havenshire, south of Death's Breach and the Havenshire Mine, north of the Havenshire Lumber Mill and the Havenshire Farms. At the beginning of the death knight starting experience, the stables house various horses; Havenshire Stallions, Mares, and Colts can be found all around the stable grounds. Death knights are sent here during Grand Theft Palomino to steal a horse which will become their deathcharger. Stable Master Kitrik patrols the stable's grounds, guarding the horses from enemies. He should be avoided, as his mount makes him difficult to escape, and he has the ability to dismount anyone trying to steal a horse. In later parts of the

Hayward Fishery was formerly a small single island prior the Cataclysm. It is now a tiny archipelago off the coast of southwestern Gilneas which houses an abandoned fishing business, that was run by the Hayward brothers: Sebastian, Ron, Trent, Walt, and Tim Hayward. The brothers were trying to repair one of their ships with the help of young Gilnean adventurers so they could escape, while at the same time being attacked by Forsaken Castaways. Oddly enough, despite the rest of the Duskhaven area having been sunken by the Cataclysm, the Fishery is all well, having not even been touched, ironically the Haywards could have stood a chance at remaining at their home rather than evacuating like the

Headed South is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Siamat with 3 stacks of Lightning Charge in Lost City of Tol'vir on Heroic difficulty. It is accomplished by killing Siamat with three stacks of Lightning Charge. This debuff is gained by being in melee range of the when it dies. In order to complete the achievement, the player must have three stacks of the debuff, requiring that it be cast by all three Servants prior to killing Siamat. The debuff remains on the player for 30 seconds, meaning that it must be refreshed or Siamat killed within 30 seconds of the previous cast. Each stack of the debuff increases damage taken by 33% and damage dealt by 10%, adding up to 100% incre
Havoc is a Destruction warlock ability. It is an exclusive choice node with Mayhem (warlock talent).
Headbutt is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Haymaker is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Haywire Sunreaver Construct can be found running along the beach of Ihgaluk Crag, on the southeastern side of the Isle of Thunder. It shares the same design as the Pyrestar Demolisher.
Haywire is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

The Haunted Stable Hand is a human ghost that can be found inside Shadowfang Keep near the entrance. As you progress through the instance, you can talk to this NPC to teleport to the rooms of certain bosses that you've killed.
Hauntng Song is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Haymon is a jungle troll standing next to and "trolling" Sanderhoof at Sanderhoof's Ledge above Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain.
Haughty Aristocrats are nightborne located in the Court of Stars.
Headbang is a pygmy who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Havi's Horn was provided as an objective for Demon Destroyer.
__NOTOC__ Head Navigator Franklin is a human located in Island Expeditions.
Haven's Breath is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Haun Fleethoof is a tauren that participates in the Darkmoon Faire's dancing contest.
The Hauling Cart is located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. It is pulled by a Mammoth Rock Snail ridden by a Snail Rider. They are travelling to and from the city, via the south-western entrance.

Heal over time (generally abbreviated as HoT) refers to a type of healing ability. A HoT does not immediately heal a target; a HoT instead heals the target for a certain amount over regular intervals. In World of Warcraft, the healing is typically applied every X seconds (X varies between different HoTs). A HoT may be applied using a variety of methods - from a spell, a bandage (see First Aid), eating food, a potion or some other form. Most HoTs are target specific, though there are also Area of Effect (AoE) HoT's such as the Druid spell Tranquility. A HoT is in principle a Buff, but usually with a much shorter duration than "normal" buffs. HoTs can usually be removed or dispelled, just like
Healing Stream Totem is a shaman ability that appears in both the class and Restoration talent trees.
Heart of the Wild is a tier 6 Druid talent with 3 ranks in the Feral Combat tree. This talent increases the druid's intellect in all forms, stamina in Bear Form, and strength in Cat Form.
Heart of Noxxion is a nature resistance trinket with the ability to remove a poison debuff.
The Heart of Hakkar is still glowing... the Zandalarian trolls will know how to destroy it.
Healer Longrunner was a tauren quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
.]] The Heart of Fury is the red shard of the ata'mal crystal. When possessed by an individual, it accentuates the individual's aggressiveness and strength.
The Heap is the remains of a destroyed fel reaver in southwestern Netherstorm. It is occupied by aggressive ethereals and is the site of the infamously bugged quest It's a Fel Reaver, But with Heart.
The Heart of the Mountain is located in the Blackrock Depths.

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Heart of Aszune |icon=BTNHeartOfAszune |desc=Legends say that the imprisoned spirit of Aszune seeks out her heart to this very day. }} The Heart of Aszune is a magical amulet. Legends say that the imprisoned spirit of Aszune seeks out her heart to this very day. The essence of the heart, called Essence of Aszune, came somehow to Dalaran.

The Headhunters are a group of Darkspear loyalists who seek vengeance for Vol'jin and can be encountered on Island Expeditions. They can also be found idling in the Port of Zandalar along with the other teams.

The Heart of Magic appears after defeating Malygos in the Eye of Eternity. The Heart contained last remnants of Malygos' essence. It was released years later in the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus on the Dragon Isles.
Heartbreaker (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating XT-002 Deconstructor after destroying his heart on 25-player mode.
Healing Surge is a shaman ability. It has a very short casting time but doesn't heal for very much and costs a very high amount of mana.
Healer Nan is a pandaren bandage trainer located in the Emperor's Step in the Shrine of Seven Stars. She is tending to Priest Whitebrow.

Heart of the Mantid Swarm is an exploration achievement earned for seeking out information behind the mantid. The four mantid lore idols and their locations are: *Cycle of the Mantid between Klaxxi'vess and the biggest clutch in the Clutches of Shek'zeer, Dread Wastes *Mantid Society north west of Lake of Stars, Dread Wastes *Amber at the back of Amber Vault, Dread Wastes *The Empress in Mantid town against the tree on the north side of Heart of Fear, Dread Wastes Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is Heart of the Mantid Swarm (item), which begins a ques

Heart of the Nightwing was originally the third special mount that players can earn only through the Recruit-A-Friend program. It first became available to players claiming their RAF reward after July 16, 2012. Obtaining this mount grants the Feat of Strength achievement Friends In Places Higher Yet. In patch 5.4.1, the Recruit-A-Friend program was updated to include a choice of one mount from all current and previous Recruit-A-Friend mounts, or one companion from event-only promotions.
Healing Flame is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Headquarters Radio is located at the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara. It is used to communicate with Horzak Zignibble.
Healing Stream is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Headlong Rush is a passive ability gained by warriors at level 15.

The Heart of the Deconstructor is part of the XT-002 Deconstructor encounter in Ulduar. Damage dealt to it is also taken by XT-002, but destroying the heart will fully heal XT-002 and engage his hard mode.

Headmaster is a title rewarded to male characters for defeating Elya Azuremoon in a phased version of Nar'thalas Academy. The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Headmaster

Headmistress is a title rewarded to female characters for defeating Elya Azuremoon in a phased version of Nar'thalas Academy. The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Headmistress

Headhunter Lani is a Zandalari troll located in the Head Shop in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Lani was cornered by the invading sethrak. She was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. During Talanji's coronation, she faced off against a Rioting Zocalo Drudge.

The Heart of Auchindoun is a crystal powering up all of 's defenses. It is made up of four pieces: *Karab'uun *Sha'tari (item) *Auch'naaru *An unnamed fourth one, that was safeguarded by the when the managed to steal the others.

The Healthy Foods factory was located in Bilgewater Port in Kezan. It was owned by Garzak Oatburner, owner of the Garzak Oatburner's Healthy Foods. The factory was surrounded by toxic oil slick; swimming through it seems to cause some sort of disease known as the sklaz. The factory was most likely destroyed when Mount Kajaro erupted.
Heart-Piercing Spine is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Headshrinker Gaha is a troll located in Island Expeditions.
Heart of Endereth is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Heart of the Deathseer is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Heart of the Forge is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Heart-Seeking Fang is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Heart of the Fae is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Fae Heart.
Hearth Kidneystone is a soulbind trait granted by Emeni. It is exclusive with Cartilaginous Legs. It grants the active abilities Attune Hearth Kidneystone and Hearth Kidneystone.

Hearthsinger Forresten is an elite rare ghost traveling singer and piccolo player located in Stratholme, in between the Live and Undead sides. He is a wandering minstrel ghost, who not only drops the , but also a trinket which causes folks to dance when you play its song. He is infamous for his oddly colored and flamboyant-sounding gear, such as the . He was a traveling performer, back when the city was alive and booming and was caught in the wrong place at the wrong time.
Heavy Timbermaw Belt gives a good bonus to Attack Power to high level mail users such as Hunters and Shaman.
Heavy Timbermaw Boots are Blacksmithing-crafted boots that give a bonus to Attack Power. These boots are good for Hunters and melee Shamans.
Heavy Stone Statue is an item. Use: Place a heavy stone statue on the ground where it will heal you for a short time before its power fades.

The Hearthglen Woods is the location where the human paladin Tirion Fordring found the orc Eitrigg. Mighty oak trees are here. Tirion was the governor of the prosperous Alliance principality of Hearthglen, a large forested region nestled at the crossroads between the towering Alterac Mountains and the mist-shrouded shores of Darrowmere Lake. Later, Lord Commander Saidan Dathrohan led a detachment into the Woods in search of renegade orcs.

A hedge wizard (or hedge mage) is usually a negative term to call wizards, sorcerers, and mages who are not liked by the Kirin Tor. Magistrate Marduke says that a "hedge mage" is a rogue wizard that never received their formal training from Dalaran. As an apprentice, most of the tales Khadgar had heard and read described independent wizards as being extremely showy, fearless in dabbling in secrets man was not meant to know, and usually dead, crippled, or damned from messing with powers and energies beyond their ken. The Heavy Copper Racer is sold by the following vendors for : * in Dalaran * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar It can also be found inside the Stolen Present and Stolen Gift during Feast of Winter Veil.

The Heavy Leaden Collection Phial is provided for the quest The Only Cure is More Green Glow. It is used to collect High Potency Radioactive Fallout from LIVING creatures in Gnomeregan that have a green glow about them. (The channeling effect has to complete before the creature dies.) Occasionally, several attempts to collect may be needed. Once gathered, the player has 2 real time hours in which to turn the quest in. Usually, there is sufficient time to complete the instance before turning the quest in, but this is dependent on the ability of the group.
Hearthstoned is a feats of strength achievement earned for obtaining and learning the Hearthsteed mount.
Heathcliff's Immortality enhances Consecration. It is named after Heathcliff from Sword Art Online.
Heathrow Keepsake was never made available. Draining the magic from it would leave behind a version that could be vendored.
The Heat Tolerant Ooze drops from Congealed Oils and Slime Elementals on Mechagon Island.
The Hefty Coin Sack is located in the Celestial Vault in the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Twilight. When picked up, it can be thrown at an enemy target, to cause damage and stun.

Heavily Bound Soul Remnants are souls located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Pull up the four Stakes, then free the soul to gain Soul Remnant's Blessing, an untimed stacking 1% agility/intellect/strength buff for the remainder of the run.

Hellfire Peninsula, once known as Tanaan Jungle, is one of the surviving parts of Draenor. It is a pivotal area of Outland that has been the location of many of the most brutal battles in Warcraft history. This is where the other side of the Dark Portal is located. Two of its past cities include Hellfire Citadel and Zeth'kur. As its name implies, Hellfire Peninsula is a grim place. In regards to topography, well, there isn't much. Aesthetically, the ground looks like it does in Durotar: reddish hue, barren, almost uninhabitable and hard-packed. There is one key difference, though — when you travel on the ground, you note bones cracking and shattering beneath your feet. These would be the rem

Helcular is a Forsaken necromancer located at the Ruins of Southshore. Helcular can also be found accompanied by Kel'Thuzad, patrolling the road to and from Southshore in the Old Hillsbrad Foothills, accessed via the Caverns of Time. Prior to the shattering, he was deceased, but could be resurrected as Helcular's Remains, as part of the Helcular's Revenge quest chain. If attacked by Alliance he summons skeletons to attack them.
Heigarr the Horrible is a kvaldir located on the southern end of the island in the middle of Njord's Breath Bay in the Borean Tundra.
Hellfire Sentry can be found in Hellfire Ramparts. They are sentinels for the commanding leader Vazruden. When they are killed he will fly down to the platform.

Hellscream's Reach is the Horde faction on Tol Barad that fought the Alliance-aligned Baradin's Wardens for control of the prison island. When in control of the zone of Tol Barad, Hellscream's Reach will offer additional daily quests.
Hellscream's Missive drops from Jor'kil the Soulripper in Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore.

Hellmondath is a pit lord summoned by High Warlock Xi'lun to take over the Redridge Mountains. However, thanks to the actions of undercover agents within Dreadmaul Rock, Xi'lun was unable to control him and the pit lord ravaged the assembled Dark Horde forces until he was killed.
Heiran Stonebelly is a pandaren located next to Donnelly Firecask at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Hellfire High Council is a boss encounter in the in Tanaan Jungle. It is a Council encounter that tests the healers' ability to heal through large amounts of raid-wide damage.

Helheim (also called Hel) is the desolate realm of the Val'kyr Helya. Here, the spirits of dishonorable vrykul spend eternity in an endless futile battle, always seeking glory but never able to attain it. Helheim is separated from the world of the living by an endless ocean called the Maw of Souls. The dread ship Naglfar delivers damned souls to Helheim by ferrying them across this sea. Helheim is connected to Haustvald and Tideskorn Harbor in Stormheim. Despite touching upon the Shadowlands, Helheim is not contained inside it. For his misdeeds, Bryndaor was cursed to guard the gates of Helheim for eternity.

The Helarjar is an order created by Helya as a mockery of Odyn's Valarjar. It is composed primarily of Kvaldir, but also includes other undead forces such as Val'kyr. The Helarjar are powerful undead tasked with hunting down heroic warriors and taking their souls to Helheim before Odyn's val'kyr can bring them to the Halls of Valor. The rotting ruins of Tideskorn Harbor are their primary Port of Call outside of Helheim, and it is here where the Maw of Souls can be entered. Not all kvaldir are made into Helarjar. It is a potential reward for their service. Living mystic vrykul also serve her as a part of the Helarjar. They use helhounds and helsquids as attack animals.
Heightened Vulnerability would have been a level 75 Marksmanship hunter talent.
Helix for Brains is one of the four snails participating in the snail race in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain, along with Zoom, Glip Gloop Haberdasher and Various and Sundry.

Hellfire Citadel trailer was the gameplay trailer for The Burning Crusade Hellfire Citadel dungeons: Hellfire Ramparts, The Blood Furnace, and The Shattered Halls. It premiered on March 13, 2007. It highlights the story about how the fortress was thought to be abandoned but discovered that it is used to create fel orcs to fuel an unnamed force that won't remain hidden for long.

Hellsreach Citadel was the main base of the on . It appears to be connected to the Blackrock Foundry and Grimrail Depot, as train tracks run through it, as well as stationed trains. It was attacked by the Lightbound armies led by High Exarch Yrel while Geya'rah and her forces teleported to Azeroth. Both and Lantressor of the Blade stayed back to defend the Citadel, and it is unknown how the battle ended, but the Lightbound forces were much more numerous.

Hemet Nesingwary is a dwarven game hunter seen in Nagrand, Sholazar Basin, Valley of the Four Winds, alternate Nagrand, Highmountain, and Zuldazar. Considered the greatest hunter on Azeroth, he led safaris to hunt the wildlife of Azeroth and beyond, and is the author of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. He is generally to be found in the wild, camped out with a group of fellow hunters, surrounded by a variety of grizzly trophies collected from the native game of the area. Nesingwary and his cohorts tutor adventurers on the hunting and trapping of wild creatures. Herac is one of the survivors of the battle of Shattrath City. He was affected by the red mist, and in the months following his escape, started the change into a Broken. He resisted the further devolution into a Lost One for some time, but eventually succumbed to the change. He disappeared shortly after, presumably wandering off into the wild.

Hemet's Happy Hunting Grounds is a large area in eastern that has many features. The land is a mix of plains, mountains, a lake with a waterfall and a river. The hunting grounds are filled with giant eels, windrocs, wolves, stags, and even a few large worms. Hemet Nesingwary is found fishing at the river here.

The Henge of the Earth Mother is a place with a crooked tree. Sulamm and Trag Highmountain arrived here to cure the latter's undead state, but the tauren shaman betrayed him to Ornamm and his kinsmen. While the two entered a trance, Ornamm moved and thrust Trag into a pit of fire. Trag awoke and returned to the tree, discovering Sulamm unable to awaken from the trance. Its exact location is unknown.

A hero class is a character class derived from the base classes, but with exclusive perks. These perks can include a unique starting experience, customization options, resources, class mounts, a higher starting level, and other flavor mechanics. The concept of a hero class is derived from the "heroes" in Warcraft III. The current hero classes are: the Death knight, the Demon hunter, and the Evoker. The term "hero class" is commonly misunderstood to mean that the class is more powerful than other classes. The term instead signifies a unique playstyle and experience, as well as denoting a class of heroes which start at an already "heroic" or "veteran" level, with an experience and gear to matc

as seen in Warcraft III.]] A hero (also called a hero unit, or rarely a legend) is a unit-type in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and the expansion Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. Heroes are very special units. They have the ability to advance in levels, collect items in a small inventory, and confer special benefits to the units near them. Heroic Strike is a warrior ability learned at level 1. It is an instant melee attack dealing physical damage. Heroic Strike shares a 1.5 second cooldown with Cleave, but is not affected by the global cooldown. Heroic Strike is a rage dump, a relatively inefficient attack designed to be used "when you have more Rage than you can spend."

Heroism is an Alliance shaman ability that increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 seconds. Heroism is available only to Alliance shamans; Horde shamans instead learn Bloodlust. The two spells are identical in every way except for the name, making it one of the bloodlust effects.
